attack_method.description: The attack method to use: 'bruteforce', 'dictionary', or 'plaintext'.

target_file.description: The path to the password-protected zip file to crack.

bruteforce_charset_type.description: Type of character set for bruteforce: 'alpha' (a-z), 'alpha-caps' (A-Z), 'numeric' (0-9), 'special' (!:$%&/()=?{[]}+-*~#@|), 'custom' (use charset_custom).

bruteforce_charset_custom.description: Custom character set string if bruteforce_charset_type is 'custom'.

bruteforce_initial.description: Initial password string to start bruteforce from. Empty string for random start.

bruteforce_max_length.description: Maximum password length to test in characters.

bruteforce_threads.description: Number of threads to distribute bruteforce load.

dictionary_file.description: Path to the dictionary file for dictionary attacks.

plaintext_use_offsets.description: Whether to use raw byte offsets (-o) for plaintext attack instead of entry names.

plaintext_source_file.description: File containing the known plaintext bytes.

plaintext_source_start_offset.description: Start offset in the plaintext source file.

plaintext_source_end_offset.description: End offset (exclusive) in the plaintext source file.

plaintext_ciphertext_start_offset.description: Start offset in the encrypted archive corresponding to the known plaintext.

plaintext_ciphertext_end_offset.description: End offset (exclusive) in the encrypted archive corresponding to the known plaintext.

plaintext_decrypt_start_offset.description: Offset in the archive where decryption begins after key recovery.

plaintext_threads.description: Number of threads to distribute plaintext attack load.
